# `aitbc blockchain list`

List all available chains with optional type, island, and sorting filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | choice | `all` | no | Filter by chain type |
| `--show-private` | flag | `false` | no | Show private chains |
| `--sort` | choice | `id` | no | Sort by field |
| `--island` | text | — | no | List attached islands when used without a value; with a value, filter chains by island ID (substring match on chain ID). |
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL (used with --island, and as the chain source when no multichain nodes are configured) <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain list
```
